name: Inflexible Power
description: The power deals more {type} damage, but less damage of all other types.

name: Sacrifice
description: The power's resource cost is replaced with a HP cost equal to 6 times the original value.

name: Added Power
description: The power deals additional $dmgType damage.

name: Assassination
description: The power has +3 critical success range against targets on full HP.

name: Cruelty
description: The power cannot cause ongoing harm, but it deals more damage against targets suffering from ongoing harm.

name: Chaining
target: powers that make ranged, single-target attacks
description: The first time the power hits whenever the power is used, you can immediately use the attack again from the target to a new target, using line of sight and range restrictions as if the original target was the attacker.

name: Infusion
target: powers that cost your highest resource
description: Whenever you use the power, you gain more damage for 1 round.

name: Monochromatic Power
description: The power deals more damage, but can only deal {type} damage.

name: Decay
description: Whenever the power hits, the target suffers slight ongoing $dmgType harm until they pass a passive save.

name: Cruel Upheaval
description: Whenever the power inflicts a condition, the ground in a 5' radius around the target becomes difficult terrain that only affects foes for the remainder of combat.

name: Vulnerability
description: Whenever the power hits, the target gains 50% vulnerability to all damage for 1 round.

name: Empowered Replenishment
description: While the power's duration is active, you recover 1 spell slot level and 1 exertion at the start of each of your turns.

name: Finishing
description: The power can now only be used after if you have already made 2 attacks this combat, but the power deals massively more damage.

name: Concentration
description: The power's areas are halved in size, but the power deals substantially more area damage.

name: Corruption
description: The power's healing is converted to causing substantial ongoing $dmgType harm, stacking until the target passes a passive save.

name: Corrosion
description: Creatures suffering the power's ongoing harm have -1 Armour.

name: Stability
description: The power deals substantially more damage, but can no longer score critical successs.

name: Preparation
description: After using the power, you must spend an action preparing the power before it can be used again, but the power deals substantially more damage.

name: Ascension
description: If you have already used the power at least twice this combat, it deals massively more damage.

name: Restoration
description: The power's healing is increased.

name: Premeditation
description: Other powers empowered by the power deal more damage.

name: Premeditated Execution
description: Other powers empowered by the power deal substantially more damage against bloodied targets.

name: Keen Resistance
description: Whenever the power scores a critical success, gain a slight amount of resistance for the remainder of combat.

name: Transmutation
description: Whenever the power inflicts the condition, the target becomes $condition instead.

name: Resilient Command
description: The power's minions gain $dmgPolarity resistance.

name: Execution
description: The power deals substantially more damage against bloodied targets.

name: Power
description: The power deals more damage.

name: Channeled Shielding
description: Whenever you lose concentration on the power, gain a massive amount of temporary HP.

name: Massive Preparation
target: powers with areas that deal damage
description: The first time the power deals damage each combat, it deals more damage and its areas are doubled in size.

name: Accuracy
description: The power's attacks have +1 AB.

name: Expansive Consideration
target: powers with areas and a cooldown
description: The power's areas are quadrupled in size, but its cooldown is increased by 1 step.

name: Eternal Decay
description: The power's ongoing harm is reduced, but creature's have a -2 penalty to their passive saves to end it.

name: Abundance
target: powers with a non-instantaneous duration that require concentration
description: The power no longer requires concentration, but its duration is reduced by 1 step.

name: Keen Splashing
description: Whenever the power scores a critical success, it splashes a substantial amount of damage.

name: Cruel Execution
description: Whenever the power scores a killing blow against a creature with a condition, your attacks deal a substantial amount of additional $dmgType damage for 1 round.

name: Endurance
description: Creatures have a -1 penalty to their passive saves against the power's effects.

name: Efficiency
target: powers with a resource cost that deal damage
description: The power's resource cost is reduced by 1 step, but it deals less damage.

name: Channeled Repulsion
description: Whenever you lose concentration on the power, all foes adjacent to you are pushed 20' away from you.

name: Considered Power
target: powers with a cooldown that deal damage
description: The power deals massively more damage, but its cooldown is increased by 1 step.

name: Upheaval
description: Whenever the power scores a standard or higher success, the ground in a 5' radius around the target becomes difficult terrain that only affects foes for the remainder of combat.

name: Cruel Power
description: Whenever the power inflicts a condition, your attacks deal additional $dmgType damage for 1 round.

name: Keen Cruelty
description: The power has +1 critical success range against targets with a condition.

name: Impending Eruption

name: Tanky Command
description: The power's minions have more resistance, but deal less damage.

name: Life Draining
description: Whenever the power scores a killing blow, you heal a substantial amount of HP.

name: Magnification
description: The power's areas are doubled in size.

name: Lasting
target: powers with a non-instantaneous duration that deal damage
description: The power's duration is increased by 1 step, but it deals less damage.

name: Pinning
description: Whenever the power scores a major success, the target becomes grappled by you for the remainder of combat.

name: Enduring Command
description: Whenever the power's minions die, they persist until the end of their next turn before actually dying.

name: Overpowering
description: Whenever the power scores a major success, the target becomes debilitated for 1 round.

name: Enduring Cruelty
description: Any conditions the power inflicts have their maximum duration doubled.

name: Growing Power
description: Whenever the power hits, you gain barely any damage for the remainder of combat.

name: Layered Decay
target: powers that cause non-stacking ongoing harm
description: The power's ongoing harm now stacks.

name: Unstable Command
description: Whenever the power's minions become bloodied, they explode, causing massive $dmgType harm to adjacent foes and immediately dying.

name: Overpowering Combination
description: Every third time you attack with the power, the target is debilitated for 1 round.

name: Scattering
description: The power can target one additional target within its reach/range, but it deals less damage.

name: Sacrificial Command
description: Whenever you use the power while you have an active minion, the minion loses HP and the power deals substantially more damage.

name: Sonic Booms
description: For every 5' space the power moves you through, all foes adjacent to that space suffer a slight amount of $dmgType harm.

name: Cascading Mass
description: The power's areas are repeated on both sides of them, on a random axis, but its areas are halved in size.

name: Channelling
description: You cannot lose concentration on the power against your will.

name: Piercing
description: The power's attacks pierce once through their targets, but deal substantially less damage after piercing.

name: Biding
description: The first time you use the power each combat, it occurs one additional time for each turn you have had this combat in which you did not use the power. The additional occurences deal slightly less damage.

name: Empowered Recovery
description: While the power's duration is active, you gain a slight amount of passive regeneration.

name: Splashing
description: The power splashes damage on hit.

name: Empowered Accuracy
description: While the power's duration is active, you gain +1 to attack rolls.

name: Prismatic Frailty
description: The power deals less damage, but gives the target reduced $dmgType resistance for 1 round on hit.

name: Prismatic Exposure
description: Whenever the power hits, the target gets slightly reduced $dmgType resistance for 1 round.

name: Reckless Consideration
description: The power can now be used one additional time within its cooldown, but its cooldown is increased by 1 step.

name: Powerful Command
description: The power's minions deal more damage.

name: Keen Eruption
description: Whenever the power scores a critical success, energy erupts from the target, causing substantial $dmgType harm to all of your foes adjacent to the target.

name: Decaying Assassination
description: Whenever the power causes ongoing harm to a creature with full HP, the ongoing harm is massively increased.

name: Keen Refreshment
target: powers with a cooldown that make attacks
description: Whenever the power scores a critical success, its cooldown is refreshed.

name: Decaying Eruption
description: Whenever a creature suffering from the power's ongoing harm dies, it explodes, causing a slight amount of $dmgType harm to all of your foes adjacent to it. This damage is multiplied by the number of ticks of the ongoing harm the creature suffered.

name: Exposure
description: The power ignores {type} resistance.

name: Rejuvenating Creations
target: powers that create objects or structures
description: You and allies adjacent to objects or structures created by the power gain a slight amount of passive regeneration.

name: Unstable Decay

name: Prepared Power
description: The power deals massively more damage, but its usage time is increased by 1 step.

name: Keen Frailty
description: Whenever the power scores a critical success, the target gets slightly reduced resistance for 1 round.

name: Keen Volatility
description: The power has -1 critical success range, but massively, massively increased critical damage bonus.

name: Necromantic Respect
description: Whenever the power would consume a corpse, the corpse is instead not consumed.

name: Merciful Power
description: The power cannot inflict conditions, but whenever it deals damage to a creature affected by a condition, the condition is removed and the power deals substantially more damage.

name: Spreading Cruelty
description: Whenever the power inflicts a condition, all foes adjacent to the target also receive that condition.

name: Myopia
description: Whenever the power scores a major success, the target becomes blinded for 1 round.

name: Shielded Execution
description: Whenever the power scores a killing blow against a creature with a condition, you gain a massive amount of temporary HP.

name: Upfront Power
description: The power deals substantially more damage during the first round of combat.

name: Close Power
description: The power deals more damage to targets adjacent to you.

name: Keen Consideration
target: powers with a cooldown that make attacks
description: The power has +3 critical success range, but its cooldown is increased by 1 step.

name: Empowered Rejuvenation
description: While the power's duration is active, you have increased incoming healing.

name: Haste
target: powers with a cooldown that deal damage
description: The power's cooldown is reduced by 1 step, but it deals less damage.

name: Aggressive Command
description: The power's minions deal substantially more damage, but have slightly reduced resistance.

name: Blessed Arrival
description: Whenever the power's movement ends, you create a 15'x15' area of glowing ground around you that persists for the remainder of combat. This area is a persistent zone that heals you and allies for barely any HP.

name: Keen Destruction
description: Whenever the power scores a critical success, the target is dazed for 1 round. Additionally, the power has massively more critical damage bonus.

name: Explosive Execution
description: Whenever a creature suffering from the power's ongoing harm dies, it explodes, causing $dmgType harm to all of your foes adjacent to it.

name: Frailty
description: Whenever the power hits, the target gets barely reduced resistance for 1 round.

name: Pure Disruption
target: powers that inflict conditions and hit
description: Whenever the power hits, the target is dazed for 1 round. Additionally, the power cannot inflict any non-dazed conditions and deals less damage.

name: Sacrificial Decay
description: The power's minions have slightly reduced passive regeneration, and the 5' radius around them is a persistent zone that causes $dmgType harm to foes.

name: Distant Power
description: The power deals more damage to target 30+' away from you.

name: Slowing Decay
description: While a creature is suffering from the power's ongoing harm, it is sluggish.

name: Repulsion
description: Whenever the power hits, the target is pushed 10' away from you.

name: Leeching
description: Whenever the power scores a standard or higher success, you heal HP.

name: Mud
description: Whenever the power scores a standard or higher success, the target becomes sluggish for 1 round.

name: Flaring
description: Whenever the power scores a standard or higher success, roll to see if your crystal flares.

name: Momentum
description: After the power has moved you 10+', it deals more damage for the remainder of its duration.

name: Keen Momentum
description: Whenever you use the power and it doesn't score a critical success, it gains +1 critical success range until you next score a critical success with it.

name: Eruption
description: Whenever the power scores a critical success, you may expend a 1st-level spell slot or 1 exertion to cause massive $dmgType harm to all foes adjacent to you.

name: Hasty Command
target: powers that summon minions which deal damage
description: The power's usage time is reduced by 1 step, but its minions deal less damage.

name: Ricochet
description: Whenever the power scores a minor success, its attack roll is increased by 2.

name: Replenishing Creations
target: powers that create objects or structures
description: You and allies adjacent to objects or structures created by the power recover 1 spell slot level or 1 exertion at the start of each of your turns.

name: Heroic Execution
description: The power deals substantially more damage to bloodied bosses.

name: Replenishment
description: Whenever the power scores a standard or higher success, you recover 1 spell slot level or 1 exertion.

name: Executing Thievery
description: Whenever the power scores a killing blow, you gain the effects of a random one of the target's passive traits for the remainder of combat.

name: Powerful Combination
description: The first time the power deals damage each combat, it deals more damage for each round of combat that has already passed.

name: Empowered Execution
description: Whenever you score a killing blow while the power's duration is active, you heal a substantial amount of HP.

name: Disruption
description: Whenever the power scores a major success, the target is dazed for 1 round.

name: Considered Intensity

name: Pure Decay
target: powers that cause ongoing harm and deal damage

name: Echoing Consideration
description: The power's areas are doubled in size and repeated at the start of your next turn, but its usage time is increased by 1 step.

name: Prismatic Power
description: The power deals more {type} damage if you haven't dealt that damage type since the start of your last turn.

name: Cruel Frailty
description: Whenever the power inflicts a condition, the afflicted creature loses barely any resistance for 1 round.

name: Spreading Decay

name: Rejuvenating Execution

description: The power deals a substantial amount of additional $dmgType damage, but deals less damage of all other types.

name: Mobility

name: Overpowering Exposure

name: Alacrity
description: The power's usage time is reduced by 1 step, but it deals less damage.

name: Delayed Decay
description: Whenever the power's duration ends, a 15'x15' persistent zone forms around its target for the remainder of combat that causes slight $dmgType harm to foes.

name: Powerful Creations
target: powers that create objects or structures
description: You and allies adjacent to objects or structures created by the power deal increased damage.

name: Cruel Stability
target: powers that inflict conditions that last until the target passes a passive save
description: Conditions inflicted by the power now last for 2 rounds.

name: Powerful Triggers

name: Immediate Power

name: Ultimate Power

name: Cruel Decay
description: Whenever the power hits a target with a condition, all types of ongoing harm on the target are slightly increased.

name: Prismatism

name: Unstable Power
description: The power deals less damage, but whenever the power deals damage, there is a 50% chance it deals substantially more damage. This is rolled repeatedly until it fails.

name: Keen Exposure
description: Whenever the power scores a critical success, the target gets reduced $dmgType resistance for 1 round.

name: Persistent Cruelty

name: Generous Command
description: The power's healing is substantially increased against minions.

name: Cruel Eruption

name: Pure Power

name: Considered Accuracy

name: Novas
